endpoints.contract: selection map, quantity, expected_revision?, request_sequence → none/partial/exact/ambiguous + allowed_values + exact variant

endpoints.contract: chỉ field hiện diện; collection mode merge/replace bắt buộc rõ → id/version

endpoints.contract: VariantWrite patch → version,parent_version
endpoints.permission: CAS variation + lock parent

endpoints.contract: `force=false` mặc định → tombstone/version

endpoints.contract: URL + metadata/renditions/provider → asset ID/version
endpoints.permission: `upload_files` + engine edit policy; URL/fetch validation

endpoints.contract: ordered refs + featured asset + variation mappings → product revision
endpoints.permission: cap + parent CAS; invalid ref không cập nhật nửa chừng

endpoints.contract: staged file ID, format/profile, update_mode, image_mode, dry_run=true mặc định → job ID

endpoints.contract: validated snapshot hash + conflict_policy → accepted job

endpoints.contract: format/profile, filters, field set, strict/lossy → job ID
endpoints.permission: cap; cursor traversal snapshot semantics khai báo

endpoints.contract: status/checkpoint/counts/errors/report artifact
endpoints.permission: creator hoặc operations cap; không expose filesystem path

endpoints.contract: cancel requested → status
endpoints.permission: cancel giữa chunks, không rollback rows đã commit

endpoints.contract: CSV/report stream/private redirect có expiry
endpoints.permission: permission mỗi download; name/path sanitize

endpoints.contract: authority/cohorts, queue lag, mismatches, index, blockers, current epoch

endpoints.contract: direction, cohort manifest, dry_run → migration job
endpoints.permission: operations cap; cohort immutable/hash

endpoints.contract: evidence snapshot → gates pass/fail
endpoints.permission: không đổi authority

endpoints.contract: gate ID, expected epoch, manifest hash → job
endpoints.permission: operations cap; gates hết hạn/phát sinh write gap phải revalidate

endpoints.contract: expected epoch, reason, dry_run → job
